mentions.name: OSS IQ
mentions.description: An open-source dependencies audit tool that helps engineering teams keep their NPM and PyPI dependencies healthy in a controlled, deterministic way, shifting focus from reactive CVE noise suppression toward leading indicators for a sustainable, predictable development cycle.
mentions.problem: Dependency auditing today is dominated by reactive CVE noise suppression rather than leading indicators that support a sustainable, predictable development cycle.
mentions.audience: Engineering teams that need to keep their NPM and PyPI dependencies healthy
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on OSS IQ Dependencies audit tool to help engineering teams keep their NPM and PyPI dependencies healthy in a controlled, deterministic way. The goal is to shift the focus away from reactive CVE noise suppression and more toward leading indicators that support a more sustainable, predictable development cycle without reliance.

evidence.value: I've been working on OSS IQ Dependencies audit tool to help engineering teams keep their NPM and PyPI dependencies healthy in a controlled, deterministic way.
